desc: Fix `zpow` sizing/indexing and revalidate all supplied samples.
Correct the sign of the new-layer contribution to the even/odd difference and verify all supplied samples.
Derive and prove the BFS-layer characterization, including unique counting of connected graphs and permitted edge types.
Derive the transition polynomial for layer sizes `(a,b)`, enforcing at least one predecessor edge for every vertex in the new layer.
Design the DP over layer sizes, parity balance, edge counts, initialization, pruning, and finalization.
Analyze the polynomial-basis transition and basic complexity considerations.
Implement the algorithm with modular arithmetic and output formatting.
